The finance industry comprises a wide array of tasks, but through consultation with experts at banks and hedge funds, we identified one core task shared across nearly all financial analyst workflows: performing research on the SEC filings of public companies.
Our Finance Agent benchmark evaluates LLMs on their ability to use tools to research and answer complex financial questions about companies, financial statements, and SEC filings.
We present the Finance Agent Benchmark, featuring challenging and diverse real-world finance research problems which require LLMs to perform complex analysis with the use of of recent SEC filings.
